One-shot backfill for effort-aware kinds whose work-done status predates

work-envelope autofill. Sets completed_at from updated_at when the work clock

is empty. Does not mutate on object get. Defaults to dry-run; pass --apply

to write.

  Preview missing work clocks
  zqk system kernel-integrity backfill-work-envelope
  Stamp completed_at from historical updated_at
  zqk system kernel-integrity backfill-work-envelope --apply

Usage:
  zqk system kernel-integrity backfill-work-envelope [flags]

Flags:
      --apply              Write completed_at stamps (implies dry-run=false)
      --dry-run            Report only; do not write (default true)
  -f, --format string      Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --limit int          Max objects to consider (0 = unlimited)
  -o, --output string      Write output to file
  -q, --quiet              Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration   Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose            Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
